summary: Controller credential types include AWS, Galaxy/Automation Hub token, Container Registry, GitHub and GitLab PATs, GCE, GPG, Machine, Azure, Network, OpenShift Bearer Token, OpenStack, AAP, Satellite, Source Control, Terraform, Vault, vCenter and secret-lookup plugins (CyberArk, HashiCorp, Azure Key Vault, Thycotic, Centrify, AWS Secrets Manager).
